claim: The AWS WAF Anti-DDoS managed rule group (AWSManagedRulesAntiDDoSRuleSet), the advanced tier of AWS WAF DDoS protection, extends protection to CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers and other AWS services supported by AWS WAF.

values.display: extends to CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers

qualifiers.scope: AWS WAF Anti-DDoS managed rule group

evidence.quote: The advanced tier of DDoS protections is offered through the `AWSManagedRulesAntiDDoSRuleSet`.
Protection extends to CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers, and other AWS services supported by AWS WAF

note: waf#57. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: the FAQ's 'Currently, resources on Amazon CloudFront, Application Load Balancer (ALB) and API Gateway are protected by this feature' is older than the Developer Guide, which extends protection to other services supported by AWS WAF; the guide is the evidence now.
